question: Who among the following poets wrote a biography of the later Chalukya ruler Vikramaditya VI?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bilhana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kashmiri poet** Kavi **Bilhana **existed in the** 11th century.**
 
• His **love poetry, Caurapancasika**, is well renowned.
 
• **King Vikramaditya VI **of the **Western Chalukya Empire** appointed him as **Vidyapathi.**
 
• **Bilhana** honoured his** patron by writing the epic Vikramankadevacharita** in his honour.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vakpati:**

 
 
• He was a** poet and author** of the **epic poem Gaudavah.**
 
 
 
• **Ballala:**
 
 
• He was the** last great king of the Hoysala Empire.**
 
 
 
• **Sandhyakar Nandi:**
 
 
• He was a** Sanskrit poet.**
 
• He is considered to be the** greatest poet of the Pala dynasty.**
 
• He became **famous for his Ramacharitam.**
